synthesis.body: Several `guides/_shared/**` files are projected into `packages/agentbundle/_data/catalogue-scaffold/`. Editing one drifts the scaffold; `make build-check` misses it and `tests/integration/test_scaffold_projection.py` catches it. The fix is `python3 tools/catalogue/sync_authoring_scaffold.py --write` — but its output lands in `packages/agentbundle/**`, which the catalogue-curation guard protects, so the commit then needs an `Engine-Change-RFC:` trailer. That trailer accepts `n/a — <reason>` for a non-engine change; precedent is in #872 and #880. Do not invent an RFC number, and do not route around the guard.

title: Editing a scaffold-projected guide requires a package-data resync AND the curation-guard trailer
